UiPath FUSION München is a wrap. Thank you to all our customers, partners and the awesome UiPathers!!
On Wednesday we filled the Sofitel Bayerpost to talk about one thing: where AI meets ROI. Not the hype. What’s actually running in production.

I opened with UiPath offering 'Controlled Agency' - allowing the best of Deterministic and Autonomous in a workflow. The role of ''the Builder of Bots'' has now evolved into ''The Architect of Work''. 

A few moments that stuck with me:
🔹
Raghu Malpani
on what’s new and what’s next across the UiPath Platform, followed by
George Barnett
on finding your path to the Map of Work.
🔹 The
Dark Testing Factory
hosted by
Gerrit Knippschild
with
Johannes Reitermayer
(LGT),
Pierluigi Mega
(Merck) and
Thomas Stocker
: a self-operating quality system, with people still setting the direction.
🔹
Wojciech Szremski
on building the foundation for scalable AI agents at Schaeffler.
🔹
Michiel van den Berg
and
Heiko Bischoff
on HARIBO’s recipe for intelligent automation with real ROI.
🔹
Michael Noll
(AOK Baden-Württemberg) and
Tim Zimmermann
(Roboyo) on AOK’s first agentic use case in production: the agent reviews, humans decide.
🔹
Justin Klemme
and
Jonas Alexander Schmidt
showing how TiMo at Rossmann assesses defects and notifies landlords automatically.
🔹
Neil Ward-Dutton
(IDC) closing with an honest look at agentic AI today and what to do about it.

Huge thanks as well to
Linda Xiang
&
Michael Grimm
(Capgemini / MAN Truck & Bus),
Ingmar Helmers
&
Joana Hermann
(cronos / Aurubis),
Samuel Porter
(Kantonsspital Graubünden),
Ferhat Datli
&
Fassih Fariwar
(M-net / Lunatec) and
Florian Huber
(Swisscom). Your stories are why people came!!

The day was a blur. Dozens of meetings, in rooms, corridors, during lunch or coffee... the place buzzed. UiPath's Map of Work was the centerstage for the buzz and what UiPath/Partners can do to make it all happen.

See you all next year!

🚀
What a day at UiPath #FUSION München!
Yesterday, customers, partners and
UiPath
colleagues from across the DACH region came together at the Sofitel Bayerpost in Munich to explore one question: how do we get from AI ambition to measurable results?

Some of my highlights:
✨
Fresh from Las Vegas:
the latest on agentic orchestration, agent governance and autonomous testing, brought to Munich for our audience.

✨
Customers and Partners on stage:
inspiring stories from Merck, Haribo, Swisscom, Schaeffler, Rossmann, Aurubis, LGT, MAN, Kantonsspital Graubünden, AOK BW, M-Net, as well as from our partners cronos, Roboyo, Lunatec, Capgemini, IDC, showing how agentic automation is already creating real value in daily business.

✨
Great news for automotive:
#UiPath
GmbH received the
#TISAX
label, confirming our information security meets the requirements of the automotive industry.

✨
The conversations:
at the booths, in the coffee area and in the meeting rooms. That’s where ideas turn into next steps.

A personal highlight was my “cooking session” on the main stage with
Michiel van den Berg
, where we served up
#HARIBO
’s recipe for creating real ROI with intelligent automation. Thank you, Michiel, for being such a fantastic Head Chef!

A huge thank you to every customer and partner who joined us and to the whole
#UiPath
team for an outstanding event.

See you at the next
#FUSION

Proud to be a launch partner in the
Fireworks Frontier Ecosystem
, announced today at Forge. 🫡 The ecosystem brings together a hand-selected group of partners across the AI stack, creating new opportunities for developers to explore, build, and bring ideas to life.
Fireworks AI
70,797 followers
3d
Building an AI product takes more than a model.

You need search and retrieval to ground it, agent frameworks to orchestrate it, evals to trust it, data to improve it and observability to run it in production. The best AI-native teams move fast because their stack works together.

Today at Forge, we’re excited to announce the Fireworks Frontier Ecosystem, a network of 60+ partners across the AI stack to help developers go from idea to production faster.

Whether you’re shipping your first agent or scaling to millions of users, the ecosystem connects Fireworks with the tools you already use:
→ Search & retrieval: ground your apps in real-time and proprietary knowledge
→ Agents & frameworks: orchestrate multi-step workflows on fast, reliable inference
→ Evals & testing: measure quality and catch problems before your users do
→ Data: build the datasets that make your product smarter over time
→ Observability: trace, debug and improve in production
→ And more!

Each Fireworks Frontier Ecosystem partner provides hands-on docs, cookbooks and guides showing how to build with Fireworks. That means you can get the code and workflows to immediately improve your product.

The future of AI belongs to the teams that build it into their products, not the ones with the biggest model. That means a stack that’s fast, open and easy to work with, from first prototype to production at scale. No single company builds all of that alone, so we’re building it together with our partners.

Thank you to our launch partners.

Explore the ecosystem and start building:
fireworks.ai/partners

Privacy Preference Center
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences, or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalization. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Social Media Cookies
Social Media Cookies
These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests. This may impact the content and messages you see on other websites you visit. If you do not allow these cookies you may not be able to use or see these sharing tools.
Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
